name: Argent Guard Manados
summary: At the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Argent Guard Manados watches for corruption across Kalimdor. He serves the Argent Dawn and sends adventurers toward Blackfathom Deeps.

sections.title: A Sentinel of the Dawn
sections.body: Argent Guard Manados keeps the Argent Dawn's watch in Darnassus. While most of the order guards Lordaeron against the Scourge, he stands among the artisans and tradefolk of the Craftsmen's Terrace. His post lets him watch for threats to northern Kalimdor's balance. When word reaches him that the Twilight's Hammer has gained a foothold beneath Ashenvale's waves, he calls on capable heroes to strike at Blackfathom Deeps and recover the cult's artifacts of dark devotion.

faq.answer: Manados is a night elf of the Argent Dawn, stationed in Darnassus. He watches Kalimdor for dark cults and otherworldly corruption while the order focuses on the Scourge in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Where can I find Argent Guard Manados?
faq.answer: You can find Manados in Darnassus, standing in the Craftsmen's Terrace. He watches over the city and coordinates with local adventurers.

faq.q: What quests does Argent Guard Manados give?
faq.answer: Manados offers Twilight Falls. He sends adventurers into Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale to retrieve Twilight Pendants from the cultists within.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn interested in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn watches for malignant forces threatening Azeroth. The Twilight's Hammer cult has emerged in Ashenvale's submerged ruins, worshipping ancient, corrupt entities, and the order cannot ignore that peril.

angles.text: As a night elf, Manados shows that duty can reach beyond the Cenarion Circle and the Sentinels. Some night elves serve neutral orders such as the Argent Dawn to preserve Azeroth.
As an Alliance champion visiting Darnassus, you can turn to Manados for a link between the distant crusades in Lordaeron and the growing cultist threat in northern Kalimdor.
